name: HX711 load cell amplifier with load cell
description: The common HX711 24-bit ADC module with a bar strain-gauge load cell on channel A (5 kg, 1 mV/V): DOUT low when a conversion is ready (10 Hz with the module's RATE low), 24 bits clocked out MSB first by PD_SCK, 25 to 27 pulses selecting the next channel and gain, power-down by holding PD_SCK high, the settling time, the data sheet's noise. The load on the cell is an interactive input.

pins.name: DT
pins.doc: DOUT: low when data is ready, then the data MSB first on SCK

pins.name: SCK
pins.doc: PD_SCK: clocks the data out; high for more than 60 us powers down

pins.name: VCC
pins.doc: Supply, 2.6 to 5.5 V (the module's AVDD regulator makes 4.3 V from it)

rate.doc: Data rate, Hz: the RATE pin low (10, as the module ties it) or high (80)

sensitivity.doc: The load cell's rated output at capacity

zero_balance.doc: The cell's output with no load (its datasheet: within +-0.1 mV/V)

noise.doc: The input noise as a multiple of the data sheet's (50 nV rms at 10 Hz); 0 for an ideal part

inputs.name: load
inputs.doc: The load on the cell (negative pulls it the other way)

functional.claims: DOUT low at each conversion at 10 or 80 Hz; 24 bits of two's complement out MSB first on PD_SCK, saturating, the 25th pulse pulling DOUT high, 25/26/27 pulses selecting A/128, B/32, A/64 next; PD_SCK high over 60 us powers down, low again resets; 4 conversion periods of settling after power-up, reset or a gain change; a ratiometric bridge (load / capacity x sensitivity + zero balance) at +-0.5 AVDD / gain full scale with the data sheet's input noise; nothing below 2.6 V.
omissions: the load cell's creep, hysteresis, nonlinearity and temperature drift
the ADC's offset and gain drift
the internal oscillator's spread (the data rate is exact)
the module's E+, E-, A+, A-, B+ and B- terminals (the cell is part of the kit; channel B reads open)

timed.claims: DOUT low at each conversion at 10 or 80 Hz; 24 bits of two's complement out MSB first on PD_SCK, saturating, the 25th pulse pulling DOUT high, 25/26/27 pulses selecting A/128, B/32, A/64 next; PD_SCK high over 60 us powers down, low again resets; 4 conversion periods of settling after power-up, reset or a gain change; a ratiometric bridge (load / capacity x sensitivity + zero balance) at +-0.5 AVDD / gain full scale with the data sheet's input noise; nothing below 2.6 V. DOUT changes 0.1 us after PD_SCK rises.
omissions: the load cell's creep, hysteresis, nonlinearity and temperature drift
the ADC's offset and gain drift
the internal oscillator's spread (the data rate is exact)
the module's E+, E-, A+, A-, B+ and B- terminals (the cell is part of the kit; channel B reads open)

electrical.claims: DT and SCK bridge to their nets; VCC's voltage sets AVDD (4.3 V, less without headroom) and gates the part; the behaviour is the Lua model's.
omissions: the load cell's creep, hysteresis, nonlinearity and temperature drift
the ADC's offset and gain drift
the internal oscillator's spread (the data rate is exact)
the module's E+, E-, A+, A-, B+ and B- terminals (the cell is part of the kit; channel B reads open)
